记录内容: Candidate-only local updates use equal samples and steps from theta0. Semantic similarity is evaluated as a donor-enrichment prior; positive transfer remains class-conditional.
Joint versus separate optimizer trajectory is the treatment. Samples, per-role gradient calls, theta0 and private selection evidence are controlled; raw update norms are reported as a diagnostic.
Natural Client-LT versus Dirichlet carrier-local association before aggregation; client size, steps, class composition and exposure are intentionally not matched.

Tests whether under-constrained c+r updates retain a smaller fraction of their local target gain under one identical real class-absent Client-LT FedAvg update. It does not attribute all of the observed 13.85pp final accuracy gap to this mechanism.
V1 measures local positive-example co-location. It does not establish positive transfer, gradient compatibility, formation of new LoRA knowledge, or an accuracy causal effect.
D1 uses fixed, norm-equalized class-absent updates. It supports state-conditioned signed functional rewriting under this frozen vision-LoRA substrate, not a universal causal claim.
D2 replays fixed saved, norm-equalized updates. It tests whether private post-write risk orders later test forgetting; it is not a full federated trajectory with client retraining.
isolated functional semantic-acquisition mechanism; not a full Client-LT accuracy decomposition
